summary: Iteration 3 regression on AI Interview Engine validating three new backlog items: (1) legacy /api/evaluate-answer deprecation (410 Gone), (2) batch-evaluation idempotency guard with cached=true and force=true bypass, (3) video upload + persistence + static serving + listing, (4) deep LLM-based cheating analysis (POST + GET). All 10 backend pytest cases passed in 56s. Frontend ResultsPage at /results/<sid> correctly renders the Proctoring Analysis card (data-testid='deep-cheating-card') and Recorded Clips section (data-testid='recorded-videos'); uploaded video is fetched from /api/videos/<sid>/<vid>.webm and rendered in a <video> element with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: evaluate-interview-batch idempotency uses only len(answers) == stored_len as the cache key — if a user resubmits the same count of answers with DIFFERENT text, the API will return the OLD cached evaluations. Consider hashing the answers payload or comparing per-index answer text to be truly idempotent. force=true is a partial mitigation.

/api/videos static mount is registered AFTER api_router but does NOT require auth, sanitize traversal, or validate the session-id segment. Anyone with a session_id+video_id can fetch the clip. For an interview engine this may need at minimum a signed URL or a session-ownership check.

InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx fires upload-video, save-cheating-analysis, evaluate-interview-batch and analyze-cheating-deep sequentially on submit (~4 awaits) — total wait can exceed 30s due to LLM latency. Consider running analyze-cheating-deep as a background task and letting ResultsPage poll, since the UI already gracefully handles 404 on the GET. Currently the user sees only a generic 'Submitting...' toast and a 1s setTimeout before navigation, which can race with slow deep-analysis (still returns ok because navigation is delayed only 1s after the await chain).

analyze-cheating-deep performs a strict json.loads on the LLM response after stripping a single ```json fence; if the model returns plain prose or multiple code fences, this raises 500. Suggest a more forgiving JSON extractor (regex match the first {...} block).
server.py is now ~895 lines — getting close to the 700-line refactor threshold; consider splitting routers into modules (sessions, evaluation, proctoring, media).

VIDEO_UPLOAD_DIR = /app/backend/uploads/videos is on the container's writable layer — fine for dev but will not persist across pod restarts in k8s; should be moved to a volume mount or object storage for production.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ sessions created via API during pytest: TEST_Backend_Engineer_v3 (used end-to-end with batch eval + cheating analysis + 1 uploaded webm clip + deep-analysis doc) and TEST_DeepCheating_Fresh (used to assert 404 on GET before POST). One uploaded webm file persists at /app/backend/uploads/videos/<sid>/<vid>.webm. Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_interview_engine.py covers, in order: health, legacy /api/evaluate-answer -> 410, batch eval (404 invalid / evaluate -> cached -> force bypass), upload-video (400 empty / 200 valid with static-serve roundtrip), interview-videos list (no _id/stored_path leakage), analyze-cheating-deep (404 before POST / 404 invalid session / 200 happy path + GET retrieval). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_interview_engine.py -v. Frontend critical data-testids on /results/<sid>: deep-cheating-card, recorded-videos. To repro frontend manually: use TEST_Backend_Engineer_v3 session id from the last pytest run (look up via GET /api/analytics/history).
verified_endpoints: POST /api/evaluate-interview-batch (404 invalid; 200 cached=false on first; 200 cached=true on rerun; 200 cached=false with force=true)
POST /api/upload-video (400 empty payload; 200 valid webm; url_path returned)
POST /api/analyze-cheating-deep (404 invalid session; 200 with full schema)
rca of the issue: N/A - no regressions found. All three iteration-3 backlog items behave as specified.
